nom: Thayers 2% AHA Exfoliating, Smoothing and Pore Refining Toner

avis.texte: I have never been so pleased with a cleansing product. All my life I have searched for something to deep clean my clogged pores especially the buildup on my crusty nose. You know the white filled yucky stuff that's difficult to remove if you especially have dry skin. I had given up on products and relied on mechanical removal by high quality towels. Now I just need a good exfoliating disposable cotton bad combined with this bad boy and poof 🌟 clean and smooth nose. Rub it long and firm enough and you can actually knock out the gel filled crusty stuff. I was SHOOK to see and achieve that. I am not proud of my past pot holes on my nose lol but for the first time EVER I could see how clean and thorough it made it so clear . I use this everyday before and after makeup.

Generally like this and I've notice a very slight improvement in texture but I use it as part of my night routine because it does make my face slightly red for a bit after application. I have dry sensitive skin so I don't use this more than once a day with moisturizer.

avis.titre: Cleans what the cleansers and scrubs miss!
avis.texte: I'm a BIG fan of another line of skincare products (the one that's been around aince 1851) but I will stay loyal to Thayers. Even though I've gotten some flack because apparently its "not as good" as the more expensive toners i could choose from, I love that this product removes dirt even after ive washed my face. And this is true both at the end of the day, when extra build-up is justifiable, and in the morning, when I've just woken up from sleeping on a clean pillowcase! I also love that i can use this toner twice a day and have zero irritation. And that it lasts forever.

This did absolutely nothing for me. I was very surprised that it was described as being refreshing when the main ingredient is water. It didn't clean my skin further after washing it, which is what toner is supposed to do. Nor did I notice any difference in my pores,blemishes or the texture of my skin. I won't be purchasing this again.
Cleared my face in 2 days!!! My pores are smaller. My skin is so smooth! Im amazed at this toner. The best one I've ever found. I wont be buying any other.

2% Aha toner works great on my skin. A little goes a long way so only a little is needed. Not for too sensitive of skin this can dry out skin somewhat if it does just use your usually moisturizer and it this product only once every few days. Love he ingredients and the product I will buy again for my skincare routine.

This toner is gentle and works great on my skin. I have very sensitive skin. I didn't have any issues with this toner at all. The scent is very light and it leaves my skin clean and refreshed. There's definitely a difference in my skin since I started using it everyday. My skin feels just so much better. I would definitely keep using it!

I love the this toner and have been using it for awhile, it really helps out with my oily skin. I have used it for other daily routines as well. I have put it on my bug bites and it works well as a repellent too.

Work great on your face. Highly recommend for anyone looking to clean there face. Overall great product works amazing. Keep or gift to friends or family. Does not burn your skins no redness or irration.

Thayer's natural remedies line is hands down my favorite. Their 2% AHA Toner with Glycolic and Lactic acids with witch hazel is great for pore refining. It is alcohol and fragrance free. It is so gentle on your skin. Try it out you will not be let down. Great product.

I would recommend this AHA Toner, but i would say if you have sensitive skin to test a small patch before putting it on your face! It has helped clear my face up! I dont use any other acidic lotions on my face.

Have been using this for a couple months. It didn't seem to work at first but I kept trying and finally started to see a difference in my pores! They look smaller and my skin texture is getting better too. I started kinda slow and was using every other day after washing my face in the evening. It stung a little at first but as my skin got used to it, it was fine and now I use it daily. The citrus smell is really clean and pleasant. I really enjoy Thayers Rose Witch Hazel and this is another great product.

Usually I LOVE Thayers products, however after using this product for almost two months daily and seeing no progress I am thoroughly disappointed. It smells amazing. However, it just just wasn't for me.

This toner has help my skin get better, I have noticed a big difference after adding this product to my skin care routine. My skin has u Proved a lot because I used to have uneven skin tone and that's getting better and most of all it won't dry or make my skin oily, it's just perfect.

avis.titre: Tried by a teen an passed.
avis.texte: So my daughter was able to try the AHA toner. She definitely approves. I can't believe it passed the test of a teen. I thought this was something that older people would use. Didn't know it would be handy and actually be a thing used today.

This facial toner is my go to every morning and evening! I have combination skin so it is hard to find a good toner that doesn't dry out my skin. I have not noticed my skin to be more dry, it is actually the exact opposite!

I received this toner in exchange for my review. I was quite excited to try a product like this from a trusted brand like Thayers! I love a good toner and the older I get the more I realize that my skin needs a bit extra. The 2%AHA is exactly that extra boost I need! The gentle exfoliating effect is divine. My skin feels smoother every time I use it. I have had no issues with sensitivity as I do with some other products. I typically use every night to every other night and have no negative effects, simply smoothed, glowing skin!

I used this product for seven days and I have received so many compliments about my skin and my skin complextion. My face looked so clear and healthy. Yes one full week. I used this product before I went to bed. And my face is not as dry and flakey.

This is one of my favorite products to use! It's not too harsh on the skin! I definitely recommend this product to anyone that is looking. It doesn't have a strong smell either thankfully! I think you will like this product!

This toner works so well for my face! I use it after a shower and my skin is breakout free and my pores look great. My skin feels so soft! Doesn't sting or burn and it even smells nice. Great product!

I like the old-fashioned, natural vibe of Thayer's products. I've been using this new 2% AHA toner for a few weeks now, and have noticed a tangible difference in my skin. At first I didn't use it twice a day as the directions say to, so I didn't see changes as fast as expected. One thing I noticed was that although it says it's fragrance-free, it isn't really. It has a distinct citrus smell to it- which I liked; but if you're looking specifically for a toner with no scent, this ain't it.

I received this toner over the weekend and started using it right away. There was no unpleasant smell and it is lightweight. It goes on the skin very easy and smooth. I cant wait to see if there are in visible changes in my skin and vanishing of any blemishes.

I have used this toner a few times and while it smells lovely I don't feel like it has done much change to my face. I do love this brand and will continue to try and see if I see a difference because this is a brand I trust and have used before.

This is a really refreshing, gentle brightening toner. I've been using this for a few weeks now and my skin really does look brighter & smoother. It doesn't sting at all so I think even those with sensitive skin would be just fine with this.

avis.titre: A 2% AHA toner with 96% natural ingredients
avis.texte: I recently got this 2% AHA toner with 96% natural origin ingredients by Thayers Natural Remedies and it is not bad overall. After using it for a bit over a week my face is unfortunately still a bit broken out (usually this passes after a week) but my skin does feel smoother which I like. The toner did not burn or feel bad on my skin, the only thing I dislike is the very noticeable citrus scent although it says it is fragrance free. Luckily the scent does not linger so I plan to finish up the bottle. I will update with an after picture if it let's me.

I'm a huge fan of this brand, and I really like this toner. I'm prone to large pores, so I have been using this twice a day (first thing in the morning, then at night after cleansing. I use Dr. Thayer facial wash too and that helps keep my skin soothed) and I started seeing a difference in about two weeks. I LOVE LOVE LOVE the scent of this! It's like a fresh citrus scent and smells so comforting.

I've always seen Thayer's at the store but never tried it until now. I typically use The Ordinary's Glycolic Acid toner, but it was a little too harsh so I was excited to try this AHA toner! There is a light citrus scent that isn't overwhelming and smells amazing! I applied this AHA toner after washing my face and was surprised by how much dirt and gunk was on the cotton pad. My face felt smooth and clean, but not tight or overly dry after using this toner. It's been a few days and I still don't feel dried out. This is definitely a keeper!

I honestly wasn't sure how well this would work, but it does numbers. I tried this on myself as well as my son. I love it ! If you are looking for something that's gonna have long lasting results this is for you

I received the 2% AHA Toner and I'm very excited of how my face looks and feels. It rehydrates my skin. My face glows now. It is very easy to use and the directions were straight to the point and easy to understand. I definitely recommend this toner.

It claims to minimize pores and I truly believe it. I can see that it minimized my pores. It also have a nice citrus smell to it. I have sensitive skin and was very amazed that it didn't burn my face or rash up. It makes my face smooth as well. I love this so far.

This is a great toner. Has AHA in it to even out skin tone. I'm very sensitive and this is a great option for me to use it also smells like citrus! Great one! Its a good size bottle should last a long time

It's a great one a the best toner I used so far. It smells good, it does not dry my skin out very bad nor make it oily neither. It is easy to use. I can only recommend everyone to try it out if it works for them.

I really like this toner! It feels very light and gentle on the skin. The scent is mild and I like how refreshing it felt on my skin. It helped minimize pores & blemishes. This is a good product that I'd recommend to anyone.

I received this from tryit sampling. I really liked this toner because it smelled great and although I haven't used it for long, it has made a difference in my skin. I would definitely continue buying this product.

I'm already an avid user of the Thayers toner brand, so I was so excited to try this. Firstoff, this has a very pleasant citrusy smell that isn't too strong at all. Product is very easy to apply and makes my skin feel very refreshed after. It doesn't sting at all when applying and just feels very fresh on your skin.I've used it for about a week or so and already noticed my pores feeling more less visible and cleaner. New addition to my skincare routine!

This 2% AHA Toner works great. It has left my face looking way brighter and fresher. It so easy to use. I love that it has so many natural products in it. I'm also happy that it isn't tested on animals.

I have noticed a difference around my eyes and at the middle brow is, were the wrinkles are coming in more deep at. The smell is not very strong either. It way better than I thought it would be. Thanks for the sample.

this toner is so refreshing to use. i always have enjoyed products by this brand and this one does not disappoint. I love they've incorporated the witch hazel into the toner. highly highly recommend!!

I am very happy with Thayer's 2% AHA Toner. I used it and my skin doesn't feel tight afterwards, it almost adds some hydration. I have used it around my eyes And it never burns or stings. My skin always feels very refreshed after using!! Great product

avis.titre: Gives my skin a sleek look
avis.texte: I love this toner! It's from the witch-hazel brand I love and trust, with the benefit of AHA chemical exfoliation. Works perfectly and has a really pleasant smell (not strong). My skin looks clean and sleek after I tone and I like that I'm keeping my pores safe from cloggy dead skin cells.

I am loving Thayers 2% AHA toner. It feels so refreshing on my face. I love the hint of citrus. It's not a strong scent at all, but just that little bit gives you a rejuvenating feeling. I've used other Thayer toners in the past as well. I really like that they use natural ingredients.

I've been using this for about a month now and I feel like my skin has been improving. My pores seems to be smaller and my skin is clearer. This time of year, I get so dry, but that seems to be better right now!

avis.titre: Add this to your skincare routine
avis.texte: I've been using this product for several weeks as part of my nighttime skincare routine. The bottle opening is small so not too much product comes out and it's easy to get the right amount onto a cotton ball. The toner exfoliates, which is much needed in the winter especially, but also reduces larger pores. My skin has felt very smooth. This is a clean product, so has also felt very gentle on my skin.

This product worlds wonders , my skin tone is evening out and I'm not having to use as much concealer and bronzer , I will continue to use this product cause it works wonders on my skin , I can't wait to see my results in 6 months

I can't rave enough about this toner. I use it everyday and it isn't harsh on my skin at all. I use it daily with my Thayers Hydrating Milky Cleanser and my skin feels amazing! My only suggestion is to make sure you wear a moisturizer with SPF.

This toner applies easily, isn't irritating, and helped my skin a little bit. I feel like my pores seem cleaner and my face is a little less red. It is a tad bit drying, but using enough moisturizer fixes that issue.

I have used this off and on for a little bit. I use it after showering and washing my face. It has made my pores appear smaller than normal. It makes my face feel soft and firm. I will definitely continue using this.

I have been using the toner for several weeks now. I enjoy the smell which is nice. I have used others before that did not smell great. Also, I noticed that this does not make my skin feel tight or too dry. So far, my experience has been good with this toner compared to others.

I have never tried this brand I have never tried a toner for my face this is the first time I tried this AHA toner and honestly I like it I have big pores in my nose so I used this toner to help reduce the pores I have been using it for about a week and I have node's the results of my pores I was a little afraid of using it at first because I thought my skin was going feel very dry but it didn't my skin actually felt cleaner and smooth but I did node's that after u applied it...it does feel smooth but my skin also felt tighter and I also like the smell of this product it smells so citrusy it smells good.

I bought this about a month ago and love it. It smells nice. It is not over powering. It is a great toner. It works great. It fades my even skin tone great. I will be buying more. And recommending it to my friends and family.

I love this brand of toner, I heard of it from a friend and wanted to try it. I have dark spots from my medication on my face and I've noticed that they going away since using this in my daily routine along with vitamin c serum. I love this stuff!

I've always been a fan of witch hazel but hate the way it smells, this toner gives me all the benefits without the overwhelming scent. Leaves my face feeling clean and fresh! Definitely a product I will purchase again.

I've been using Thayers Natural Remedies for years now! This is the first product I've tried that included AHA, Glycolic & Lactic Acids. This brand is renowned for using Witch Hazel instead of alcohol, which initially drew me to try their products in the first place! The Toner was gentle on my skin, yet effective! It didn't burn, or give any harsh side effects whatsoever. It's easy to use, and has significantly helped improve my skin just with 2 weeks time alone! I'm a true believer that all natural products CAN, & DO WORK!!

I was very excited to try Thayer's 2% toner and it didn't disappoint. This is a great product to add to your skincare routine. It does a wonder job of cleansing and hydrating the skin in one step. My face feels so smooth instead of dry and red. It is gentle and effective. The retinol really gives my face a fresh youthful appearance. I will be continuing to use this product.

I was having a break-out along my jawline when I began using this 2% AHA toner. My first use was in the evening, and my skin was clearer the next morning. After two more days, the break-out was completely cleared up! So impressive! It didn't dry out my skin like the usual things I use for break-outs, and it was gentle on my skin too, so I'm very, very happy!

Thayer's is an excellent brand and their toner just keeps proving how excellent! My pores looked smaller within about 6 days of using it twice daily. I was amazed at how much healthier my skin looked. I love it!

I bought this toner because I need something to help with my skin and this toner does the trick. I use this product along with a facial cleanser and they work very well together; I have started a daily facial regimen and I am really tell a difference in my skin; my skin is more even tone, smoother and less greasy. I am really enjoying this product

There always seemed to be something missing from my skincare routine. I wanted to try a toner and had heard of Thayer's excellent reputation for improving skin's overall appearance. I was excited when I found this 2% AHA Toner with glycolic and lactic acid. Thayer's uses witch hazel in their toners as well. Witch hazel is known for having a multitude of benefits for your skin. The directions for use state to use this toner two times per day. I apply it in the morning after cleansing my face and before beginning my makeup routine. At night, I apply it again before bed. Since I began using this toner, I have noticed an incredible difference in the way my skin looks and feels. My face looks hydrated and healthy. My skin glows under my makeup and my complexion has greatly improved. I have very sensitive skin and this toner is alcohol free and fragrance free which are two things I must have in a skincare product. It is non-drying and only enhances your skins natural appearance. This toner has been a wonderful addition to my skin care routine.

This toner is great ! I put it on in the morning and before bed. It makes my face feel so refreshed. This will now be my go to toner. It helps remove any residual dirt or make up. It also hydrates my skin and doesn't dry it out like some toner do.

This toner is amazing. It's gentle on my skin and doesn't burn or irritate. It helps clear my pores and minimize them and makes my face look more glowing. I started seeing a difference after 5 days of using this product ad I love it! I use it every day!

So I've been using this for just over 2 weeks, and I'm in love! I have super sensitive, dry skin, so I'm always nervous introducing any acids into my skin care. I do use tretinoin, so my skin DOES have some experience with them. I've noticed a difference in the appearance of my pores very quickly... and I pay almost TOO close attention to my skin, lol. I would say this would be a great place for someone who's never used acids to start because it's so gentle, but also a wonderful addition for a "pro". I will absolutely continue to use this daily, and would definitely recommend it to anyone... especially those who are looking to introduce an acid in their regimen

This is by far up and away my new favorite toner. This toner did not leave any residue behind and my skin feels super clean, refreshed and soft. The citrus in this particular one made me feel calm and relaxed at the same time and it smells great!

I am usually hesitant in trying new facial products because my skin is so sensitive but this toner did not break out my skin at all. Used it for about a week, twice a day before I noticed my skin looking more glowey.

Thayers toner has been around for a while but this new version has some great new ingredients that really improve it. It now has bucolic and lactic acid with witch hazel. I use this at least once a day after washing my face or after I use a mask. It smells pretty great and I believe it is improving the size of my pores.

I love this brand and was excited to try this new product. The AHA is a chemical exfoliant that helps brighten my skin. It has a citrus scent from natural extracts, and it's alcohol free. I have combination skin and did not find it to be too drying. Make sure to wear sunscreen since AHAs can cause sun sensitivity! This is a great, affordable product.

This 2% AHA TONER works wonders. My daughters are makeup wearers and this certainly helps as a extra cleanser. They used to have a lot of acne but, that soon disappeared. After toning the face go behind it with a good moisturizer.

It immediately cleanses and hydrates your skin while leaving it so smooth. It feels like everything is perfectly balanced in my skin now,I'm blown away by how good my skin feels. I'm always going to keep this close by

This toner is my favorite that I've used in a long time. The toner gives my skin a hydrating glow that has gotten me many compliments. The toner contains no harsh chemicals or parabens. It has a wonderful aroma. The retinol is extremely beneficial, and the toner is milky but dries clear. This toner is suitable for all skin tones and complexions, leaving the skin soft, hydrated, and shiny.

This is one of my favorite toners! The brand is excellent and love their products. It makes your skin feel soft and hydrated. It has a scent to it so make sure you don't have reactions to fragrances. A little goes a long way with this toner, you really don't need much to cover your face. My skin looks more radiant and healthy since using!

I got this 2% AHA TONER to try! I would say this works really good and leaves my face looking smoother and smelling great! compare to other toners this one didn't leave my face feeling tight. I also like the price of it too.

Toner is one of those things that is really hit or miss with me. It either burns but works, or doesn't burn but also doesn't work. I've used Thayer's before and wasn't a huge fan of the original scents. The rose smell was too grandma-like and the cucumber made me hungry. This toner surprisingly me with a light, citrus smell that I immediately fell in love with even before putting it in my skin. Within a week I could feel a change in my skin. I usually have these dry patches on my checks, but this gently exfoliated those patches away without me even noticing. It is crazy to find a toner that my skin actually responds to and doesn't burn the living life out of it. I will continue to purchase this toner as long as they make it!

My 14 year old son and I have been using this toner for a week and we have loved it. I've noticed that my skin is softer and more smooth. The smell is so fresh and clean I look forward to using it each day.

I got this Thayers 2% toner with witch hazel from try it sampling to try I love it because one it's all natural remedy and it has witch hazel in it which has been proven to help skin so not only does it refine your pores it also gives your skin a refreshing boost without harsh chemicals

avis.titre: Great new addition to my routine.
avis.texte: I haven't used a toner in a long time but I love this Thayers toner. This is also my first Thayers product used. Over the last week, I have loved how my makeup and non makeup looks have been. My skin looks so much healthier and feels refreshed. I love even more that my eyes don't burn after using the product. There is the slightest sent of citrus from the ingredients used, which is refreshing versus a product with added fragrance. This product will stay in my skincare routine.

I started using this last week and already am seeing amazing results!! It has helped reduce Redness and dark spots and really leaves my skin feeling light and refreshed….. just really clean! I absolutely love the light scent!

I have always loved Thayers products. This one is no exception. This toner is gentle on my skin, yet effective on keeping my face moisturized. It smooths out my skin and has noticeably shrunken my pores. It's a great addition of my skin care routine.

I got this for my husband as he tends to breakout from working out. It has semi-clean ingredients, I wish they would do without the phenoxyethonol as a preservative as I tend to be sensitive w/it. Also instructions are a little off it says to use day and night but i would be cautious to use in the morning as these ingredients make you susceptible to sun damage. So I only have him use at night. So far its helping him keep his skin clear as its easy to use.

I recently started using a toner in my skincare routine. I love this one because it has a nice smell of oranges to it. It doesn't dry out my skin either like some toners can feel like they do. Since this toner contains glycolic and lactic acids it has a very moisturizing effect. I have noticed that my pores are starting to appear smaller after consistent use!

The bottle of product is pretty sizable. It contained no alcohol and was fragrance free. It works pretty well for my sensitive skin. It did not sting and was pretty gentle. I have tried a lot of different toners and this one is one of my favorites.

This toner helps control my adult acne and leaves my face very smooth and calm. I use it once a day. The lemongrass smell is very clean-smelling. I have not had problems with it drying my skin. I would definitely buy this again and I definitely recommend trying it.

This toner makes my skin feel so clean. I can wash my face with add soap and come back and wipe my face with the toner and it gets all the dirt off. I would recommend this toner to any and everybody. Yes

My daughter wanted to try this product as she had heard good things about it! We grabbed a bottle and she began using it the next day. She absolutely loves how it makes her face feel and how easy it is to apply! She uses it daily before getting her makeup on and it evens out everything perfectly! Have a customer for life!

I have always had an issue with large pores but with sensitive skin and wanted to use a toner. Most that I find are very harsh and irritate my skin making it very red! This is the MOST gentle toner I've tried. My pores look smaller and does not burn of dry out my skin. It's the perfect balance!

I'm really happy to have added this step to my skin care routine. I'm fairly low maintenance, serum+eye cream+moisturizer so adding this in wasn't super overwhelming. I use an exfoliating pad to wipe this on my face and after 2 weeks my pores are considerably smaller and less noticable and my skin is softer. The only downside is that the unscented toner, is absolutely scented. There is a ever so slight citrus smell. It isn't overwhelming, but it's definitely there.

I have been using Thayers 2% AHA Toner for a few weeks and my skin feels great. It doesn't leave my skin feeling dry or dehydrated. It feels soft and smooth. I do notice that my blemishes are fading away and my face is not breaking out like it use to. This product saved me money by not going to the dermatologist just for them to prescribe me some expensive medicine that don't work. It does provide as an extra cleanings for me too. I will definitely keep continuing to use this toner.

I've tried many different toners before and never really had any improvements in completion. This toner though, within a week I could see changes, my blemishes and pores were smaller and less noticeable. It also doesn't have that really bad "sting" to it like some others do. Great product.

I really like this toner. It removed any last traces of dirt that was stuck in my pores after I washed my face. I could tell the difference after the first use. It helped minimize the appearance of pores and my face feels much smoother without the harshness. I would definitely recommend.

My teenager has some skin issues as we all usually do at that age. I suggested adding a toner to her routine and it had certainly helped all around with the skin evenness and she is happy with the results. I really love this brand as they always have quality products and you seem to get a lot of bang for your buck which always helps these days!

Thayers 2% AHA Toner is a great product. My skin felt and looked great after using it. My pores look smaller after a few days. I love that this is fragrance free and alcohol free. It is gentle on my skin.

This is an amazing toner. For having an AHA it is very mild. My skin has never felt more clean. I have noticed a more clear complexion and my makeup looks more even when applied. Over all I notice a more youthful complexion.

I have been using this toner as part of my regular skincare routine and I'm very happy with it! My pores are clear and the texture of my skin has improved. This toner is gentle and not irritating and has not caused any breakouts. I'm impressed by this product and I highly recommend it!

Okay this product is amazing I use it nightly now and my face has never felt cleaner my pores are reducing and my skin feels smoother than ever . I first wash my face with the hydrating milky cleanser then this toner then a moisturizer all and all buy this product asap!

I like this product and have been using it daily for over a week now. I haven't seen a huge improvement in my skin just yet but I'm hopeful. It smells great with a citrus scent that is not over powering. It does not dry my skin out like I was scared it would do.

I haven't used toner too much as part of my skincare routine, but I'm trying to step up my skincare game. I'm experiencing some hormonal acne now that I'm in my forties and so I take extra special care of my skin nowadays. I use this toner after my shower or when I wash my face in the morning and at night. It says that it's fragrance-free but it definitely has a light citrus fragrance. It leaves my skin feeling so soft and fresh. I can definitely fee the difference.

This product does wonders for my face and pores. I use it twice a day for the best results. I use it once in the morning and once at night before I apply my moisturizer. It doesn't irritate my skin, or leave me feeling dry. It also smells really good.

I've been using this on my skin and it works really good I've noticed less blackheads and my skin is getting really soft you will not be disappointed with this product I will definitely recommend to family and friends.

This toner works wonders. I am surprised at my face looking so young and fresh. It made my pores to minimize and helped in curbing breakouts. My skin looks supple and young. Will definitely buy more. 2% AHA Toner is a skin saver. No harmful chemicals. Made from Natural extract of Glycolic and lactic acids from lemon orange, bilberry sugarcane. This one is a skin miracle in a bottle.

After about 5 days of use, my pores looked super toned. It's overall made my face look very smooth. Also after issuing this toner, my fave felt hydrated all day long. I really love that it's alcohol free and fragrance free because my skin has been loving that lately!

I'm not real big into using many face products. I use a cleanser at night and also a little night cream. Recently I added a use of a toner into my routine. Picking this toner was a great choice. It has a very mild/lemony scent. I don't do well with scented products as they make me nauseous. This scent is very clean and mild. Bottle has an opening on top for squeezing the toner onto a cotton ball. My face definitely needed this toner. My face feels fresh and rejuvenated.

This facial toner works wonders! Toner is easy to apply and does not leave my face feeling dry! Face felt cleaner after using and pores were minimized after 3 or 4 days of using this toner. This toner also have a lovely citrus scent.

I've been using this toner for a little over a week now. I have noticed an improvement in my skin already, clearer pores and cleaner-brighter looking skin. I have been washing my face in AM and using afterwards and before make-up. In the evening I use it after I get out if the shower. I am excited to watch for more improvements in my skin!

I actively seek out products with AHA at the recommendation of my esthetician. I have used this product every other day as part of my skincare routine. I've previously used other witch hazel toners, but not from this brand. This toner, while billed as unscented, has a very nice citrus aroma. I love how clean and fresh my skin feels after using it. I also think it brightens my skin without an unpleasant drying effect that I've found with other products. I would recommend it for anyone who likes the cleansing effect of toner looking to add AHA to their skincare regimen.

avis.titre: Doesn't feel abrasive on my skin.
avis.texte: When I apply this toner it feels less like an alcohol and more like a hydrating but clarifying cleanser water which I really appreciate.
